dataset: FalseQA (Hu et al., ACL 2023), github.com/thunlp/FalseQA at commit 9a9729974d8c5cfbfc6929e5b830111c0ed7c0c7
pairing: data row i of the label-1 block with data row i + n of the label-0 block (no pair id in the files)
draw: one random.Random(seed): sample(test pool, n_test), then sample(valid pool, n_dev)
